backup_transport_encryption_enabled.title: Backup Transport Encryption Enabled
backup_transport_encryption_enabled.description: Whether the backup data transfer channel uses encryption (e.g., TLS/SSL) during transit from source database to backup storage.

backup_protocol.title: Backup Transfer Protocol
backup_protocol.description: The network protocol used to transfer backup data from the source to backup storage.

minimum_tls_version_enforced.title: Minimum TLS Version Enforced
minimum_tls_version_enforced.description: The minimum TLS protocol version explicitly configured and enforced for backup data transfer channels.

deprecated_protocol_fallback_enabled.title: Deprecated Protocol Fallback Enabled
deprecated_protocol_fallback_enabled.description: Whether the backup transfer channel permits fallback to deprecated SSL/TLS versions during negotiation failures.

cipher_suite_policy.title: Cipher Suite Policy
cipher_suite_policy.description: The cipher suite restriction policy applied to the backup transfer channel, indicating whether weak or export-grade ciphers are permitted.

weak_cipher_categories_present.title: Weak Cipher Categories Detected
weak_cipher_categories_present.description: Categories of weak or dangerous ciphers found in the permitted cipher suite list (NULL, EXPORT, RC4, non-AEAD). Should be empty if no weak ciphers are permitted.

mutual_tls_enforced.title: Mutual TLS Enforced
mutual_tls_enforced.description: Whether the backup storage endpoint requires and validates client TLS certificates during the backup data transfer session, enforcing bidirectional authentication.

client_certificate_validation_mode.title: Client Certificate Validation Mode
client_certificate_validation_mode.description: The mode in which the storage endpoint validates backup client certificates (none, optional, or required).

application_layer_integrity_verification.title: Application-Layer Integrity Verification Enabled
application_layer_integrity_verification.description: Indicates whether cryptographic checksums (e.g., SHA-256, HMAC) are applied to backup data segments at the application layer, independent of transport-layer protection.

transport_layer_protection_mechanism.title: Transport Layer Protection Mechanism
transport_layer_protection_mechanism.description: The transport-layer security mechanism applied to backup data in transit (e.g., TLS, IPSec, VPN, none).

anti_replay_mechanism_enabled.title: Anti-Replay Mechanism Enabled
anti_replay_mechanism_enabled.description: Whether the backup transfer protocol enforces nonce-based or sequence-number-based anti-replay controls to prevent replayed sessions from overwriting newer data.

backup_session_integrity_verification.title: Backup Session Integrity Verification Method
backup_session_integrity_verification.description: The method used to verify the integrity and freshness of a backup session at the storage endpoint, preventing acceptance of replayed older sessions.

certificate_chain_validation_enabled.title: Certificate Chain Validation Enabled
certificate_chain_validation_enabled.description: Whether the backup agent validates the full TLS certificate chain for the storage endpoint, ensuring the certificate is signed by a trusted CA.

hostname_verification_enabled.title: Hostname Verification Enabled
hostname_verification_enabled.description: Whether the backup agent verifies that the TLS certificate's subject/SANs match the storage endpoint hostname, preventing impersonation via certificate mismatch.

tls_mode.title: TLS Enforcement Mode
tls_mode.description: The TLS enforcement mode configured for the backup agent's connection to the storage endpoint.

backup_transfer_rate_limiting_enabled.title: Backup Transfer Rate Limiting Enabled
backup_transfer_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Indicates whether rate limiting or bandwidth throttling is applied to the backup data transfer channel, preventing full line-speed data exfiltration.

backup_anomaly_detection_enabled.title: Backup Flow Anomaly Detection Enabled
backup_anomaly_detection_enabled.description: Indicates whether network anomaly detection or SIEM alerting is configured to flag abnormal volume or throughput patterns in the backup data flow.

bgp_route_origin_validation_enabled.title: BGP Route Origin Validation (RPKI) Enabled
bgp_route_origin_validation_enabled.description: Indicates whether RPKI-based Route Origin Validation is configured on routers handling backup traffic paths, preventing prefix hijacking via illegitimate route announcements.

backup_network_segment_type.title: Backup Network Segment Type
backup_network_segment_type.description: Classifies whether backup traffic traverses a dedicated private network segment or shared/public routing infrastructure, indicating exposure level to interception and BGP-based route manipulation.

backup_schedule_type.title: Backup Schedule Type
backup_schedule_type.description: Whether backup transfers occur on a fixed/predictable schedule or a randomized/dynamic schedule, affecting timing predictability for attackers.

backup_schedule_publicly_documented.title: Backup Schedule Publicly or Broadly Documented
backup_schedule_publicly_documented.description: Whether the backup schedule is documented in places accessible to non-privileged users, runbooks visible to broad staff, or otherwise discoverable without privileged access.

backup_transfer_jitter_minutes.title: Backup Transfer Schedule Jitter Configured
backup_transfer_jitter_minutes.description: Whether any random time offset (jitter) is applied to the scheduled backup start time to reduce timing predictability. False indicates no jitter is applied.

key_exchange_channel_protocol.title: Key Exchange Channel Protocol
key_exchange_channel_protocol.description: The protocol used to transmit symmetric encryption keys for backup stream protection to the backup agent or storage target.

key_exchange_server_authentication_enfor.title: Key Exchange Server Authentication Enforced
key_exchange_server_authentication_enfor.description: Whether the channel used to deliver the backup encryption key performs mutual or at minimum server-side certificate/identity authentication, preventing interception by an unauthenticated endpoint.

key_material_appears_in_plaintext_logs_o.title: Key Material Exposed in Plaintext Logs or Config
key_material_appears_in_plaintext_logs_o.description: Whether the backup encryption key or key derivation inputs are present in plaintext in configuration files, environment variable dumps, or application logs accessible without encryption.
